lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué buscas? Tengo una pregunta—ooh, what moved? Just one more lap. Five more minutes. Your attention span? Huge potential.
lines.translation: Hello! What are you looking for? I have a question—ooh, what moved? Just one more lap. Five more minutes. Your attention span? Huge potential.
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain leaks with municipal confidence. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; looking directly merely relocates the problem. A tiny firecracker pops.

lines.native: ¡Sí, miro! Pero sigo en movimiento. You got my eyes, not my feet. ¿Qué quieres que haga? Una pregunta—ooh, a spark. Just one more lap?
lines.translation: Yes, I’m looking! But I’m still moving. You got my eyes, not my feet. What do you want me to do? A question—ooh, a spark. Just one more lap?
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, looking involves three laps and a tiny firecracker. Nothing resembling a halt occurs.

lines.native: ¡Vale, quieto! No me muevo. Your attention span? Suspiciously powerful. ¿Por dónde voy? Tengo una pregunta—ooh, dust. We could pick a direction tomorrow. Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: All right, still! I’m not moving. Your attention span? Suspiciously powerful. Which way do I go? I have a question—ooh, dust. We could pick a direction tomorrow. Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without him; apparently it has fewer commitments.

lines.native: ¿En español? Necesito una dirección. English feet? Not installed. ¿Por dónde voy? Tengo una pregunta—oh, una mosca. Just five more minutes.
lines.translation: In Spanish? I need a direction. English feet? Not installed. Which way do I go? I have a question—oh, a fly. Just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! Muy bien. Pero mañana. Hoy quiero descansar. Direction skills? Ten out of ten. Tengo una pregunta: ¿cuándo empezamos? Wait—just five more minutes.
lines.translation: To the left, yes! Very good. But tomorrow. Today I want to rest. Direction skills? Ten out of ten. I have a question: when do we start? Wait—just five more minutes.
lines.narrative: Flick edges left at the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops; apparently, movement requires an announcement.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, perfecto! Pero quieres empezar, ¿no? Mañana es otro día. ¿Cuándo empezamos? Tengo una pregunta—oh, una mosca. Just five more minutes. Your delay skills? Ten out of ten.
lines.translation: Tomorrow, perfect! But you want to start, right? Tomorrow is another day. When do we start? I have a question—oh, a fly. Just five more minutes. Your delay skills? Ten out of ten.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has poor reception.

lines.native: ¡Ahora! Sí, entiendo. No mañana. ¡Vamos a la izquierda! Tengo una pregunta: ¿qué tiene dos pies y—oh, una mosca. Fine. You win. Five more minutes? No? Tough crowd.
lines.translation: Now! Yes, I understand. Not tomorrow. Let's go left! I have a question: what has two feet and—oh, a fly. Fine. You win. Five more minutes? No? Tough crowd.
lines.narrative: Flick appears at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops beside a calendar whose only date is Tomorrow. For once, it looks worried.
